description: Result of discussion_comment_write. The shape depends on the 'method' argument: comment mutations ('add', 'reply', 'update', 'delete') return the affected comment's node ID and URL; answer mutations ('mark_answer', 'unmark_answer') return the parent discussion's node ID and URL.

anyOf.title: add | reply | update | delete
anyOf.description: Minimal identity of the discussion comment that was created, replied to, updated, or deleted.

id.description: GraphQL node ID of the discussion comment.

url.description: HTML URL of the discussion comment.

anyOf.title: mark_answer | unmark_answer
anyOf.description: Minimal identity of the discussion whose answer was marked or unmarked.

discussionID.description: GraphQL node ID of the discussion that contains the comment.

discussionURL.description: HTML URL of the discussion that contains the comment.
